subject.title: refactor(agents): retire TOOLS.md into an AGENTS.md section with a doctor migration

question: Should upgrading workspaces be allowed to lose `TOOLS.md` prompt context until an operator manually runs Doctor, or should the product surface a required/visible migration before retirement takes effect?
rationale: The repository policy treats new operator action and removed fallback behavior as compatibility-sensitive; the code can preserve a canonical runtime path either way, but the user upgrade experience is a product choice.

options.title: Require visible upgrade migration
options.body: Run or prominently surface the Doctor migration before the retired file is excluded from effective workspace guidance, while keeping runtime reads canonical afterward.

options.title: Accept manual Doctor recovery
options.body: Keep the current one-time manual Doctor requirement and document that existing local tool notes are absent from runtime context until migration.

recommendation.title: Require visible upgrade migration
recommendation.body: Run or prominently surface the Doctor migration before the retired file is excluded from effective workspace guidance, while keeping runtime reads canonical afterward.

likelyOwner.reason: The current change and the related merged workspace-attestation work are both authored by this recent area contributor.
